description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for header ABI checking, including running header-abi-dumper, header-abi-linker, and managing build variables related to Android VNDK and target architectures.

classes.name: Target
classes.description: Represents a build target with methods to get architecture and CPU string representations.

methods.name: run_header_abi_dumper
methods.description: Runs header-abi-dumper to generate ABI dump from input file.

methods.name: run_header_abi_linker
methods.description: Links multiple ABI dumps into a single output.

methods.name: make_targets
methods.description: Builds specified targets using Soong build system.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Builds all lsdump files for a given product and variant.

methods.name: make_libraries
methods.description: Builds lsdump files for specific libraries.

methods.name: get_lsdump_paths_file_path
methods.description: Returns the path to lsdump_paths.txt for a product and variant.

methods.name: read_lsdump_paths
methods.description: Reads lsdump paths from lsdump_paths.txt, optionally building the file.

methods.name: find_lib_lsdumps
methods.description: Finds lsdump files for specified libraries and target.

methods.name: run_abi_diff
methods.description: Runs ABI diff between two dump files.

methods.name: get_build_vars_for_product
methods.description: Retrieves build system variables for a product and variant.
